title: HeteroVDiff: Pipelining Video Diffusion across Mobile NPU and GPU with Shared Weights
title_zh: HeteroVDiff：通过共享权重在移动 NPU 和 GPU 之间流水线处理视频扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Video generation is moving from the cloud to phones for privacy and offline use, and the applications often ask for several clips at a time. So video generation on phones is a throughput problem before it is a latency problem. Contemporary mobile SoCs carry both a GPU and a neural processing unit (NPU) on shared DRAM. Yet on-device video diffusion systems run the denoiser on one of them. The other engine either sits idle or only decodes the finished latent afterwards. The heterogeneous designs developed for mobile LLMs do not carry over, because they synchronise the two engines at every operator and partition weight tensors between the engines rather than sharing one stored copy. In this paper we first measure the platform limits that decide what can run on this class of SoC. They include how large one buffer may be, whether both runtimes can map the same buffer, and how much activation memory the NPU toolchain lets one graph hold. Drawing on these measurements, we store the base weights once in INT8 in the layout the NPU reads natively. The GPU uses the same bytes directly as integer dot-product operands, so neither runtime rearranges the weights on load. We then flatten the denoising trajectory into its full sequence of block executions and cut it once at a block boundary, so the GPU runs the prefix and the NPU the suffix. We place the cut from measured rather than modelled rates. Those rates include the decoder that only the NPU can run. They are taken while both engines run together, because each engine’s speed changes when the other is active. By employing these techniques we present HeteroVDiff , which serves a multi-expert video diffusion model across the NPU and the GPU using 48% less weight memory than giving each engine its own copy. Generating videos back to back on a Galaxy S25 with decoding inside the pipeline, HeteroVDiff sustains 1.35 × 1.35\times the stream throughput of NPU-only execution. On VBench-2.0, HeteroVDiff matches FP32 in the total score over all 18 dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成正从云端转向手机，以实现隐私保护和离线使用，而应用程序通常一次需要生成多个片段。 因此，手机上的视频生成首先是一个吞吐量问题，而非延迟问题。 当前的移动 SoC 在共享 DRAM 上同时集成了 GPU 和神经处理单元（NPU）。 然而，设备端的视频扩散系统仅在其中其中一个单元上运行去噪器。 另一个引擎要么处于空闲状态，要么仅在事后解码已生成的潜在表示。 为移动 LLM 开发的异构设计并未直接沿用，因为它们在每个算子上都会同步两个引擎，并将权重张量在两者之间划分，而非共享一份存储副本。 在本文中，我们首先测量了决定此类 SoC 上可运行任务的平台限制。 这些限制包括缓冲区最大容量、两个运行时能否映射到同一缓冲区，以及 NPU 工具链允许单个图占用多少激活内存。 基于这些测量结果，我们将基础权重以 INT8 格式一次性存储为 NPU 原生读取的布局。 GPU 可直接使用相同的字节作为整数点积操作数，因此两个运行时在加载时都不会重新排列权重。 接着，我们将去噪轨迹展平为完整的块执行序列，并在一个块边界处进行一次切割，使 GPU 运行前缀部分，NPU 运行后缀部分。 切割位置基于实测速率而非模型预测速率确定。 这些速率还包括仅由 NPU 可运行的解码器。 这些速率是在两个引擎同时运行时测得的，因为每个引擎的速度会随另一个引擎的激活而改变。 通过采用这些技术，我们提出了 HeteroVDiff，它能在 NPU 和 GPU 之间协同运行多专家视频扩散模型，相比为每个引擎分配独立副本，可节省 48% 的权重内存。 在 Galaxy S25 上连续生成视频时，若将解码集成到流程中，HeteroVDiff 可维持 NPU 单独执行时吞吐量的 1.35 × 1.35 倍。 在 VBench-2.0 测试中，HeteroVDiff 在所有 18 个维度上的总分与 FP32 相当。

paragraphs.en: Generative video diffusion has progressed from closed research demonstrations to open model releases and product previews ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wiedemer et al., 2025 ) . With these models, an application no longer selects a precomputed asset but synthesises a short clip for a specific user when it is needed. Representative applications include personalised video advertising, audio-driven avatars, video virtual try-on, and interactive scene generation ( Kapoor and Kumar, 2025 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Karras et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Most of these applications need many clips at once. An advertising feed renders one clip per product, an avatar one per audio segment, a try-on session one per shortlisted garment, and scene generation one per user action. Such an application therefore waits for a whole set of clips, and it cares about how long the set takes rather than how long any single clip takes. On a phone one clip already takes minutes, so the time for a set comes down to the rate at which the device completes clips. That rate decides whether such an application is usable, and we call it stream throughput .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频扩散技术已从封闭的研究演示发展为开放模型发布和产品预览（Brooks 等，2024；Wan 等，2025；Kong 等，2024；Yang 等，2025；Wiedemer 等，2025）。 借助这些模型，应用程序不再选择预计算的资产，而是在需要时为用户合成一个短片段。 典型应用包括个性化视频广告、音频驱动虚拟形象、视频虚拟试穿以及交互式场景生成（Kapoor 和 Kumar，2025；Tian 等，2024；Karras 等，2024；Yu 等，2025）。 这些应用大多需要一次性生成大量片段。 广告信息流会为每个产品渲染一个片段，虚拟形象会为每个音频片段生成一个，试穿过程会为每件入围的服装生成一个，场景生成则会根据用户操作生成一个。 因此，这类应用程序需要等待一整套片段，其关注的是整组片段所需的时间，而非单个片段的耗时。 在手机上，单个片段就已经需要数分钟，因此生成一整组片段的时间取决于设备完成每个片段的速度。 这一速度决定了此类应用是否可用，我们将其称为流吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: The phone already has the hardware to raise this rate, but no published system uses all of it. A modern smartphone integrates a programmable neural processing unit (NPU) and a graphics processing unit (GPU) that share the same physical DRAM ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e ; Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024d ; Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024a ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Yet on-device diffusion systems run the denoiser on one of them, as Figure 1 shows. Some works ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2024b ; Ben Yahia et al., 2025 ) shrink the model until it fits mobile constraints and run it on a single engine, and recent video systems ( Karnewar et al., 2026 ; Ghafoorian et al., 2026 ) place the whole diffusion transformer on the NPU. One system ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) uses the GPU only for the decoder, so the two engines run in sequence rather than together. In every case the GPU stays outside the denoising computation.
paragraphs.zh: 手机已经具备提升这一速率所需的硬件，但目前没有任何已发布的系统能充分利用这些硬件。 现代智能手机集成了可编程神经处理单元（NPU）和图形处理单元（GPU），二者共享相同的物理 DRAM（Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e；Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024d；Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024a；Wei et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2025）。 然而，如图 1 所示，设备端扩散系统仅在其中一个单元上运行去噪器。 一些研究（Wu et al., 2025b；Zhao et al., 2024b；Ben Yahia et al., 2025）将模型压缩至符合移动设备限制，并在单个引擎上运行；而近期的视频系统（Karnewar et al., 2026；Ghafoorian et al., 2026）则将整个扩散变换器部署在 NPU 上。 某项系统（Zhao et al., 2026）仅将 GPU 用于解码器，因此两个引擎是顺序运行而非并行运行。 在所有这些情况下，GPU 都未参与去噪计算。

paragraphs.en: The idle GPU matters because such sets of clips have strong reasons to be generated on the device rather than remotely. When conditioning data contain personal information, remote processing raises privacy and compliance considerations ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2016 ; State of California, 2018 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . Remote execution is exposed to network latency, and under load to queueing before denoising begins ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Ahmad et al., 2025 ) . At scale, centralised generative inference also incurs recurring cloud-GPU serving cost per clip ( Miao et al., 2024 ) . Image diffusion and language models have already moved towards on-device execution ( Zhao et al., 2024b ; LLM, 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . The video systems above follow the same path, but repeated transformer execution creates a different deployment problem for video.
paragraphs.zh: 空闲的 GPU 之所以重要，是因为这类剪辑集有充分的理由在设备本地生成，而非远程生成。 当条件数据包含个人信息时，远程处理会引发隐私和合规性问题（欧洲议会和欧盟理事会，2016；加利福尼亚州，2018；Liu 等，2021）。 远程执行会受到网络延迟的影响，并且在负载较高时，还需要在去噪开始前排队等待（Wang 等，2020；Ahmad 等，2025）。 在大规模应用中，集中式生成推理还会产生每段剪辑持续产生的云 GPU 服务成本（Miao 等，2024）。 图像扩散模型和语言模型已经朝着设备本地执行的方向发展（Zhao 等，2024b；LLM，2025；Chen 等，2025）。 上述视频系统也遵循了同样的路径，但重复的 Transformer 执行为视频部署带来了不同的问题。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of modern video diffusion make it hard to run on a phone. First, one video executes L L transformer blocks over N N denoising steps, yielding N ⋅ L N{\cdot}L block executions against a shared latent. Few-step distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ) reduces N N from tens to a few ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , but it does not remove this repeated structure. Second, recent multi-expert diffusion models specialise denoisers for different noise regimes ( Balaji et al., 2022 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Xue et al., 2023 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . For example, the Dual-expert Consistency Model (DCM) ( Lv et al., 2025 ) freezes its semantic expert and adds timestep-dependent embeddings and a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of the attention projections for detail refinement. TimeStep Master also attaches timestep-specific LoRA experts to a shared base model ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) . Together, these properties create long accelerator occupancy and a large persistent weight footprint. In a stream these costs are paid again for every clip. The time a clip occupies the accelerator sets how fast clips complete, and the weights must stay in memory for the whole stream.
paragraphs.zh: 现代视频扩散模型的两个特性使其难以在手机上运行。 首先，一个视频会在 N 个去噪步骤中执行 L 次 Transformer 模块，从而在共享的潜在空间上产生 N ⋅ L 次模块执行。 少步蒸馏（Salimans 和 Ho，2022；Song 等，2023）将 N 从几十减少到几个（Yin 等，2025；Li 等，2024），但并未消除这种重复结构。 其次，近期的多专家扩散模型为不同的噪声范围专门设计了去噪器（Balaji 等，2022；Feng 等，2023；Xue 等，2023；Wan 等，2025）。 例如，双专家一致性模型（DCM）（Lv 等，2025）会冻结其语义专家，并添加与时间步相关的嵌入以及用于细节优化的注意力投影的低秩适配（LoRA）。 TimeStep Master 也会为共享的基础模型附加特定于时间步的 LoRA 专家（Zhuang 等，2025）。 这些特性共同导致了加速器占用时间过长以及较大的持续权重占用。 在流式处理中，这些成本需要为每个片段重复支付。 一个片段占用加速器的时间决定了片段完成的快慢，而权重则必须在整个流式处理过程中保留在内存中。

sents.en: Two properties of modern video diffusion make it hard to run on a phone.
sents.zh: 现代视频扩散模型的两个特性使其难以在手机上运行。

sents.en: First, one video executes L L transformer blocks over N N denoising steps, yielding N ⋅ L N{\cdot}L block executions against a shared latent.
sents.zh: 首先，一个视频会在 N 个去噪步骤中执行 L 次 Transformer 模块，从而在共享的潜在空间上产生 N ⋅ L 次模块执行。

sents.en: Few-step distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ) reduces N N from tens to a few ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , but it does not remove this repeated structure.
sents.zh: 少步蒸馏（Salimans 和 Ho，2022；Song 等，2023）将 N 从几十减少到几个（Yin 等，2025；Li 等，2024），但并未消除这种重复结构。

sents.en: Second, recent multi-expert diffusion models specialise denoisers for different noise regimes ( Balaji et al., 2022 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Xue et al., 2023 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 其次，近期的多专家扩散模型为不同的噪声范围专门设计了去噪器（Balaji 等，2022；Feng 等，2023；Xue 等，2023；Wan 等，2025）。

sents.en: For example, the Dual-expert Consistency Model (DCM) ( Lv et al., 2025 ) freezes its semantic expert and adds timestep-dependent embeddings and a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of the attention projections for detail refinement.
sents.zh: 例如，双专家一致性模型（DCM）（Lv 等，2025）会冻结其语义专家，并添加与时间步相关的嵌入以及用于细节优化的注意力投影的低秩适配（LoRA）。

sents.en: TimeStep Master also attaches timestep-specific LoRA experts to a shared base model ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: TimeStep Master 也会为共享的基础模型附加特定于时间步的 LoRA 专家（Zhuang 等，2025）。

sents.en: Together, these properties create long accelerator occupancy and a large persistent weight footprint.
sents.zh: 这些特性共同导致了加速器占用时间过长以及较大的持续权重占用。

sents.en: In a stream these costs are paid again for every clip.
sents.zh: 在流式处理中，这些成本需要为每个片段重复支付。

sents.en: The time a clip occupies the accelerator sets how fast clips complete, and the weights must stay in memory for the whole stream.
sents.zh: 一个片段占用加速器的时间决定了片段完成的快慢，而权重则必须在整个流式处理过程中保留在内存中。

paragraphs.en: A cross-engine system could use the two engines and the shared DRAM to address both costs. With a stream of clips, the GPU can run part of the denoising computation while the NPU runs the rest, so both engines are busy at the same time. Because they share physical DRAM, they can also read one stored copy of the weights instead of holding one each. This does not make a single video faster, because its trajectory is serial and the GPU is slower per block, but it shortens the period between finished videos in the stream. That period is the stream throughput the applications above wait on, so we target it rather than single-video latency.
paragraphs.zh: 一种跨引擎系统可以利用这两种引擎和共享的 DRAM 来解决这两方面的成本问题。 对于视频片段流，GPU 可以执行部分去噪计算，而 NPU 则处理剩余部分，这样两种引擎就能同时保持忙碌状态。 由于它们共享物理 DRAM，因此也可以读取一份存储的权重副本，而不是各自保留一份。 这并不会让单个视频的生成速度更快，因为其处理流程是串行的，且 GPU 每块的处理速度较慢，但它能缩短流中连续视频完成之间的时间间隔。 这个时间间隔正是上述应用程序所等待的流吞吐量，因此我们的目标是优化它，而非单个视频的延迟。

paragraphs.en: Three deployment obstacles stand between this opportunity and a practical cross-engine system. First, cross-engine execution requires a compatible stored weight representation without maintaining engine-specific converted copies. Each accelerator runtime normally expects weights in its own layout, so adding an engine requires a separately converted representation. Every converted copy adds to the memory the weights occupy, and multi-expert models add expert parameters on top. Second, a partition must balance two asymmetric engines. But the balance is not a simple ratio of block rates, because the decoder runs only on the NPU and adds a fixed per-video cost to its side. Fine-grained GPU–NPU execution has been used for mobile LLMs, where HeteroInfer partitions each weight tensor so that both engines compute the same layer concurrently ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Applied to video diffusion, a boundary at every block execution would require N ⋅ L N{\cdot}L synchronisation points per video, each of which has to make the whole activation available to both runtimes before either engine proceeds. Cutting only at step boundaries avoids the coordination but leaves too few places to balance two engines of very different speed. Third, the platform has limits that no data sheet states. How large one buffer may be, whether both runtimes can map the same buffer, and how much activation memory the NPU toolchain lets one graph hold are all capped, and the caps are found only by trying. When both engines run at once they also compete for DRAM bandwidth and power, so a block takes a different time than running alone. No existing system clears all three obstacles, so a multi-expert video model still has no exact cross-engine serving path on a phone.
paragraphs.zh: 三个部署障碍阻碍了这一机会与实用化的跨引擎系统之间的实现。 首先，跨引擎执行需要兼容的存储权重表示，而无需保留针对特定引擎转换后的副本。 每种加速器运行时通常期望权重以自身布局存在，因此添加新引擎就需要一个单独转换后的表示形式。 每个转换后的副本都会增加权重所占用的内存，而多专家模型还会在此基础上增加专家参数。 其次，分区必须平衡两个不对称的引擎。 但这种平衡并非简单的区块速率之比，因为解码器仅在 NPU 上运行，并为其侧边增加了每段视频的固定开销。 精细粒度的 GPU–NPU 执行已用于移动 LLM，其中 HeteroInfer 对每个权重张量进行分区，使两个引擎能并行计算同一层（Chen et al., 2025）。 若应用于视频扩散模型，每个区块执行处设置边界将导致每段视频需要 N ⋅ L 个同步点，而每个同步点都必须在任一引擎继续执行前，将全部激活值提供给两个运行时。 仅在步骤边界处进行切割虽可避免协调问题，但会留下太少的位置来平衡速度差异极大的两个引擎。 第三，平台存在数据手册中未说明的限制。 缓冲区最大允许大小、两个运行时能否映射同一缓冲区，以及 NPU 工具链允许单个图占用多少激活内存等，都存在上限，而这些上限只能通过实际尝试才能确定。 当两个引擎同时运行时，它们还会争夺 DRAM 带宽和功耗，因此一个区块的运行时间与单独运行时不同。 目前没有任何系统能同时克服这三个障碍，因此多专家视频模型在手机上仍没有精确的跨引擎服务路径。

paragraphs.en: We present HeteroVDiff , a system that serves a multi-expert video diffusion model across the NPU and the GPU of one phone, evaluated on a Snapdragon 8 Elite with a two-expert model. It answers the three obstacles with three novel designs. First, the base weights are stored once in INT8 using the layout the NPU reads natively. The GPU uses the same bytes directly as operands of its integer dot-product instruction, so neither runtime rearranges the weights on load. Both runtimes map the same physical pages, and the NPU dequantises the block it is executing to FP16 in a scratch buffer that the next block overwrites, so each engine keeps its own fastest arithmetic while the memory stores only one copy. Second, the denoising trajectory is flattened into its N ⋅ L N{\cdot}L block executions and cut once at a block boundary, which may lie inside a step. The GPU runs the block executions before the cut, and the NPU runs the rest and then the decoder, so in a stream the GPU starts video i + 1 i{+}1 while the NPU finishes video i i . Every block still runs in order on the full activation, so the partition is algorithmically exact. We place the cut from rates measured while both engines run together, with the decoder’s per-video cost. Third, the platform limits are measured first and designed around. We measure how large a buffer can be, which buffers both runtimes can map, how much activation memory one graph may hold, and how much each engine speeds up or slows down when the other runs. The size limits set how the weights are divided into buffers, the co-run rates set the cut, and the same rates predict the throughput.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HeteroVDiff，这是一个能够在单部手机的 NPU 和 GPU 上运行多专家视频扩散模型的系统，并在搭载骁龙 8 Elite 芯片的设备上对双专家模型进行了评估。 它通过三种创新设计克服了这三个障碍。 首先，基础权重仅存储一次于 INT8 格式中，并采用 NPU 原生读取的布局。 GPU 可直接使用这些字节作为其整数点积指令的操作数，因此两个运行时在加载时都不需要重新排列权重。 两个运行时共享相同的物理页，NPU 在执行某个块时将其反量化为 FP16 并存储到临时缓冲区中，而下一个块会覆盖该缓冲区，这样每个引擎都能保持自身最快的算术运算，同时内存只需存储一份副本。 其次，降噪轨迹被展平为 N ⋅ L 个块的执行序列，并在一个块边界处进行一次切割，该边界可能位于某个步骤内部。 GPU 在切割前执行这些块，而 NPU 则执行剩余部分并随后运行解码器，因此在流式处理中，GPU 开始处理视频 i + 1，同时 NPU 完成对视频 i 的处理。 每个块仍然按照顺序在整个激活张量上运行，因此这种划分在算法上是精确的。 我们基于两个引擎协同运行时测得的数据以及解码器每段视频的开销来确定切割点。 第三，我们首先测量平台限制，并围绕这些限制进行设计。 我们测量了缓冲区可容纳的最大容量、两个运行时均可映射的缓冲区大小、单个图可能占用的激活内存量，以及当一个引擎运行时另一个引擎的速度变化。 尺寸限制决定了权重的缓冲区划分方式，协同运行速率决定了切割点，而相同的速率也用于预测吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate HeteroVDiff on a Galaxy S25 running DCM-Wan2.1, measuring performance and scoring output quality. On a stream of 49-frame videos, HeteroVDiff completes one every 677 677 s and NPU-only every 917 917 s, a stream-throughput gain of 1.35 × 1.35\times . The gain rises to 1.50 × 1.50\times at 17 frames. The gain holds under a service-level objective (SLO). HeteroVDiff sustains 5.3 5.3 videos per hour against 3.9 3.9 for NPU-only while every video meets the deadline. The two-engine pipeline holds 1.47 1.47 GiB of weights, half the 2.83 2.83 GiB that data parallelism needs for its two working sets. Quality is unchanged within 0.2 0.2 pp of FP32 in VBench Quality score and within 1.3 1.3 pp in VBench-2.0 score.

paragraphs.en: The Galaxy S25 uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e ) , whose two accelerators share DRAM. Its Hexagon V79 NPU couples the HVX vector unit with the HMX matrix unit. HMX multiplies 32 × 32 32{\times}32 INT8 or FP16 tiles held in VTCM in a fixed tile order ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2026 ; Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e ) . The NPU is reached over FastRPC ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024b ) and runs offline-compiled QNN context binaries ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024c ) with fixed shapes and an activation-footprint limit. The Adreno 830 GPU ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024a ) runs OpenCL with INT8 dp4a and no matrix unit. Usable memory is 10.85 10.85 GiB. The runtimes share memory only through DMA-BUF descriptors ( Linux Kernel Developers, 2024 ) from AHardwareBuffer ( Android Developers, 2024 ) or the Hexagon heap, which the CPU, GPU and DSP map at once. QNN accepts memory only in this form. Appendix A expands this section.

paragraphs.en: This section reports what we measured when we deployed a dual-expert video diffusion model on a Galaxy S25. The workload is DCM-Wan2.1 ( Lv et al., 2025 ) at its released configuration. It generates 49 frames at 832 × 480 832{\times}480 in N = 6 N{=}6 denoising steps. The diffusion latent has C z = 16 C_{z}{=}16 channels and F z = 13 F_{z}{=}13 temporal positions. Its spatial dimensions are H z = 60 H_{z}{=}60 and W z = 104 W_{z}{=}104 . The DiT uses p = 2 p{=}2 and d = 1536 d{=}1536 , giving d z = 64 d_{z}{=}64 values per latent patch and M = 20,280 M{=}20{,}280 tokens. Each step runs L = 30 L{=}30 DiT blocks. The measurements expose three linked questions: why whole-video assignment fails, how both runtimes can access the same base-weight copy, and where the cut should fall.

paragraphs.en: The obvious way to use both engines is to hand each of them whole videos, and that fails for two independent reasons. First, at the solo rates in Table 1 , the N ⋅ L = 180 N{\cdot}L{=}180 DiT block executions take 2,350 2{,}350 s on the GPU and 603 603 s on the NPU, a 3.90 × 3.90\times difference. Second, the GPU cannot finish a video at all, because the Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) GPU backend defines no Conv3d and the decoder never runs there. Using both engines therefore requires splitting each trajectory once between them. The next feasibility question is whether both runtimes can access the model without duplicating its weights.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , the two engines do not agree on a precision either. paragraphs.en: The obvious repair is to keep one base-weight copy that both runtimes read. The platform will not allow us to allocate it naively. paragraphs.en: HeteroVDiff treats the B = N ⋅ L B=N{\cdot}L DiT block executions of one video as a single flattened sequence. The GPU executes the prefix [ 0 , k b ) [0,k_{b}) DiT blocks, while the NPU executes the suffix [ k b , B ) [k_{b},B) and decodes the final latent with the VAE. Both engines read the same stored base-weight artifact. It contains INT8-quantised weights in the NPU’s native HMX tile layout and one FP32 scale per output column. The GPU consumes these weights directly as dp4a operands. The NPU uses FP16 operands for its GEMMs and caches the dequantised feed-forward weights for the current block (§ 4.2 ). The GPU writes the hidden state X t , ℓ ∈ ℝ M × d X_{t,\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} and the patchified running latent z ¯ t ∈ ℝ M × d z \bar{z}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d_{z}} at the cut. The NPU then resumes inside the same denoising step (§ 4.3 ). The selected cut also falls before the first expert switch, so the GPU runs only the semantic expert and the NPU handles the switch locally (§ 4.3 ). The GPU GEMMs use INT8 operands, while the NPU GEMMs use FP16 operands (§ 4.2 ). The GPU keeps the state between blocks in FP16 and uses a separate scale for each GEMM input. These choices limit error accumulation across the quantised block sequence (§ 4.4 ). At each denoising step, the host CPU projects the current latent into DiT tokens, maps the final hidden state back to a latent-space prediction, and applies the Euler update to obtain the latent for the next step. The mechanisms assume only a stack of DiT blocks whose base weights quantise to INT8 and a denoising trajectory that repeats those blocks on one latent, so N N and L L are free in the flattened sequence. Neither assumption involves DCM or its LoRA experts.
paragraphs.zh: HeteroVDiff 将一段视频中 B = N ⋅ L B=N{\cdot}L DiT 块的执行视为一个单一的扁平化序列。 GPU 执行前缀 [ 0 , k b ) [0,k_{b}) DiT 块，而 NPU 执行后缀 [ k b , B ) [k_{b},B) 并用 VAE 解码最终的潜在变量。 两个引擎都读取相同的已存储基础权重工件。 该工件包含以 INT8 量化的权重，采用 NPU 原生的 HMX 瓦片布局，以及每个输出列的一个 FP32 缩放因子。 GPU 直接将这些权重用作 dp4a 操作数。 NPU 使用 FP16 操作数执行其 GEMM 运算，并为当前块缓存去量化的前馈权重（§ 4.2）。 GPU 在切割点处写入隐藏状态 X t , ℓ ∈ ℝ M × d X_{t,\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} 和分片化的运行潜在变量 z ¯ t ∈ ℝ M × d z \bar{z}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d_{z}}。 NPU 随后在同一去噪步骤中恢复执行（§ 4.3）。 所选的切割点也位于首次专家切换之前，因此 GPU 仅运行语义专家，而 NPU 在本地处理切换（§ 4.3）。 GPU 的 GEMM 运算使用 INT8 操作数，而 NPU 的 GEMM 运算使用 FP16 操作数（§ 4.2）。 GPU 以 FP16 格式在块之间保留状态，并为每个 GEMM 输入使用独立的缩放因子。 这些选择在量化后的块序列中限制了误差累积（§ 4.4）。 在每个去噪步骤中，主机 CPU 将当前潜在变量投影为 DiT 令牌，将最终隐藏状态映射回潜在空间预测，并应用欧拉更新以获得下一步骤的潜在变量。 这些机制仅假设一个 DiT 块堆栈，其基础权重可量化为 INT8，以及一个在单个潜在变量上重复这些块的去噪轨迹，因此 N N 和 L L 在扁平化序列中是自由的。 这两个假设均未涉及 DCM 或它的 LoRA 专家。

sents.zh: GPU 执行前缀 [ 0 , k b ) [0,k_{b}) DiT 块，而 NPU 执行后缀 [ k b , B ) [k_{b},B) 并用 VAE 解码最终的潜在变量。

sents.en: Both engines read the same stored base-weight artifact.
sents.zh: 两个引擎都读取相同的已存储基础权重工件。

sents.en: It contains INT8-quantised weights in the NPU’s native HMX tile layout and one FP32 scale per output column.
sents.zh: 该工件包含以 INT8 量化的权重，采用 NPU 原生的 HMX 瓦片布局，以及每个输出列的一个 FP32 缩放因子。

sents.en: The GPU consumes these weights directly as dp4a operands.
sents.zh: GPU 直接将这些权重用作 dp4a 操作数。

sents.en: The NPU uses FP16 operands for its GEMMs and caches the dequantised feed-forward weights for the current block (§ 4.2 ).
sents.zh: NPU 使用 FP16 操作数执行其 GEMM 运算，并为当前块缓存去量化的前馈权重（§ 4.2）。

sents.en: The GPU writes the hidden state X t , ℓ ∈ ℝ M × d X_{t,\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} and the patchified running latent z ¯ t ∈ ℝ M × d z \bar{z}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d_{z}} at the cut.

sents.en: The NPU then resumes inside the same denoising step (§ 4.3 ).
sents.zh: NPU 随后在同一去噪步骤中恢复执行（§ 4.3）。

sents.en: The selected cut also falls before the first expert switch, so the GPU runs only the semantic expert and the NPU handles the switch locally (§ 4.3 ).
sents.zh: 所选的切割点也位于首次专家切换之前，因此 GPU 仅运行语义专家，而 NPU 在本地处理切换（§ 4.3）。

sents.en: The GPU GEMMs use INT8 operands, while the NPU GEMMs use FP16 operands (§ 4.2 ).
sents.zh: GPU 的 GEMM 运算使用 INT8 操作数，而 NPU 的 GEMM 运算使用 FP16 操作数（§ 4.2）。

sents.en: The GPU keeps the state between blocks in FP16 and uses a separate scale for each GEMM input.
sents.zh: GPU 以 FP16 格式在块之间保留状态，并为每个 GEMM 输入使用独立的缩放因子。

sents.en: These choices limit error accumulation across the quantised block sequence (§ 4.4 ).
sents.zh: 这些选择在量化后的块序列中限制了误差累积（§ 4.4）。

sents.en: At each denoising step, the host CPU projects the current latent into DiT tokens, maps the final hidden state back to a latent-space prediction, and applies the Euler update to obtain the latent for the next step.
sents.zh: 在每个去噪步骤中，主机 CPU 将当前潜在变量投影为 DiT 令牌，将最终隐藏状态映射回潜在空间预测，并应用欧拉更新以获得下一步骤的潜在变量。

sents.en: The mechanisms assume only a stack of DiT blocks whose base weights quantise to INT8 and a denoising trajectory that repeats those blocks on one latent, so N N and L L are free in the flattened sequence.
sents.zh: 这些机制仅假设一个 DiT 块堆栈，其基础权重可量化为 INT8，以及一个在单个潜在变量上重复这些块的去噪轨迹，因此 N N 和 L L 在扁平化序列中是自由的。

sents.en: Neither assumption involves DCM or its LoRA experts.
sents.zh: 这两个假设均未涉及 DCM 或它的 LoRA 专家。

paragraphs.en: while both experts reuse the same feed-forward weights. Keeping the factors separate avoids storing a second full-rank attention copy and avoids requantising a small adapter after it is merged into the base. Both device runners consume this representation at run time. The NPU runs the two factor GEMMs inside its block kernel and adds the result to the base projection in FP16. The GPU computes the same low-rank delta and fuses it into the GEMM epilogue before requantisation. Merging the adapter into an INT8 base is not merely unnecessary: the adapter’s magnitude is about one third of the base’s requantisation noise, so a merged INT8 copy cannot represent the two experts distinguishably at weight level, whereas the factorised path applies the delta at full precision. The factorised expert representation is the only part of HeteroVDiff that is specific to DCM. A single-expert model omits it, and a model whose experts each carry a full base stores one shared artifact per expert under the same design.

paragraphs.en: HeteroVDiff consists of a device-side coordinator, an OpenCL GPU DiT executor, and a FastRPC NPU DiT executor. The coordinator assigns the block executions before the cut to the GPU executor and the rest to the NPU executor, launches them for each video, and sequences the one handoff between them. At the handoff the GPU passes two tensors, the hidden state and the running latent, and the NPU resumes at block k b k_{b} even when the cut falls inside a denoising step. Each executor runs the per-step patch embedding, output head and Euler update on the CPU in its own process, in place on the shared buffers the accelerator has just written, without copying them. Both DiT executors bypass the QAIRT graph runtime. The NPU VAE decoder uses the QNN Hexagon Tensor Processor (HTP) backend separately after the last block of each video, so in a stream the GPU prefix of video i + 1 i{+}1 overlaps the NPU suffix and the decode of video i i .
paragraphs.zh: HeteroVDiff 由设备侧协调器、OpenCL GPU DiT 执行器和 FastRPC NPU DiT 执行器组成。 协调器将切割前的块执行分配给 GPU 执行器，其余部分分配给 NPU 执行器，为每个视频启动它们，并在两者之间按顺序进行一次交接。 在交接时，GPU 会传递两个张量——隐藏状态和运行中的潜在变量，而 NPU 则从块 k b k_{b} 开始继续执行，即使切割发生在去噪步骤内部也是如此。 每个执行器都在其自身进程中于 CPU 上运行每步的块嵌入、输出头和欧拉更新，直接操作加速器刚刚写入的共享缓冲区，无需复制数据。 两个 DiT 执行器都绕过了 QAIRT 图运行时。 NPU VAE 解码器在每个视频的最后块之后单独使用 QNN Hexagon 张量处理器（HTP）后端，因此在一个流中，视频 i + 1 i{+}1 的 GPU 前缀会与视频 i i 的 NPU 后缀和解码过程重叠。

paragraphs.en: The NPU DiT executor calls a custom Hexagon operator package directly. The QNN HTP backend prevents external operators from using HMX. It also cannot serialise the full attention graph at the deployment shape without slicing it. Both executors expose the same block-range interface and read the artifact described in § 4.2 .

paragraphs.en: At startup, each block’s base weights are placed in a shared DMA-BUF. The NPU maps the buffer through FastRPC. The GPU imports the same buffer through Qualcomm’s OpenCL host-pointer extension. When the two executors run as separate processes, the NPU-side owner passes the per-region file descriptors to the GPU process over a Unix-domain socket. The runtimes use different handles and virtual addresses for the same physical pages in shared memory. The rank-128 adapters, detail-expert timestep embeddings, and the NPU’s block-local FP16 scratch remain separate from this shared base. Appendix B describes the NPU and GPU DiT kernels and the VAE decoder.
paragraphs.zh: 启动时，每个区块的基础权重会被放入一个共享的 DMA-BUF。 NPU 通过 FastRPC 映射该缓冲区。 GPU 通过高通公司的 OpenCL 主机指针扩展导入同一个缓冲区。 当两个执行器以独立进程运行时，NPU 侧的所有者会通过 Unix 域套接字将每个区域的文件描述符传递给 GPU 进程。 运行时环境对共享内存中相同的物理页面使用了不同的句柄和虚拟地址。 秩为 128 的适配器、细节专家的时间步嵌入以及 NPU 的区块本地 FP16 临时存储，均与这个共享基础部分保持独立。 附录 B 描述了 NPU 和 GPU 的 DiT 内核以及 VAE 解码器。

paragraphs.en: Every timed run is cold . The phone sits on an external cooler with the screen off and stays plugged in. Both controls hold the device in one operating state, so that the differences we report come from the schedule rather than from heat or a draining battery.

paragraphs.en: The primary metric is stream throughput , reported as seconds per video over a stream of 10 content-diverse prompts generated back to back with decoding inside the pipeline. For the two-engine pipeline it is the steady-state period after the initial fill. We also report single-video latency from launch to finished decode, SLO attainment and resident memory. The SLO is a per-video deadline of 1.5 × 1.5\times the NPU-only single-video latency at the same workload. Output quality is scored on the seven VBench quality dimensions, and on 18 VBench-2.0 dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 主要指标是流吞吐量，以每段视频所需的秒数表示，该数据基于连续生成 10 个内容多样化的提示并在管道内进行解码的流得出。 对于双引擎管道，该指标为初始填充阶段结束后的稳态周期。 我们还报告了从启动到完成解码的单视频延迟、SLO 达成率以及驻留内存。 SLO 是每段视频的截止时间，等于相同工作负载下仅使用 NPU 时的单视频延迟的 1.5 × 1.5\times。 输出质量根据 VBench 的七个质量维度以及 VBench-2.0 的 18 个维度进行评分。

paragraphs.en: All self-built configurations consume the same INT8 base-weight artifact and apply the factorised expert representation of § 4.2 at run time, so they differ only in how execution is divided between the two engines. NPU-only runs the whole trajectory and the decoder on the NPU. It is the strongest single engine and serves as the ( 1 × 1{\times} ) reference throughout. GPU-only runs the DiT on the GPU and decodes on the NPU, because the vendor GPU backend has no 3D convolution and therefore cannot run the VAE decoder. DP is naive data parallelism in which both engines generate whole videos from one prompt queue with separate working sets. The NPU worker decodes the GPU worker’s latents as they arrive. Hetero-Tensor is the per-GEMM column split of HeteroInfer ( Chen et al., 2025 ) in which both engines compute a slice of every GEMM and exchange results after each one. HeteroInfer has no public code, so we implemented the split ourselves following the paper. HeteroVDiff places one block-level cut at the k b k_{b} that Equation 4 selects from co-run rates for each workload, namely 51 51 , 54 54 , 59 59 and 61 61 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有自构建配置都消耗相同的 INT8 基础权重工件，并在运行时应用 §4.2 中的因子化专家表示，因此它们仅在两个引擎之间如何划分执行流程上有所不同。 NPU-only 模式在 NPU 上运行整个轨迹和解码器。 这是最强的单一引擎，并在全文中作为 (1×1{\times}) 的参考基准。 GPU-only 模式在 GPU 上运行 DiT，并在 NPU 上进行解码，因为供应商提供的 GPU 后端不支持 3D 卷积，因此无法运行 VAE 解码器。 DP 是一种朴素的数据并行方法，其中两个引擎从单个提示队列生成完整的视频，但各自使用独立的工作集。 NPU 工作进程在接收到 GPU 工作进程的潜在表示后立即进行解码。 Hetero-Tensor 是 HeteroInfer（Chen 等人，2025）的每次 GEMM 列分割方案，其中两个引擎分别计算每个 GEMM 的一个切片，并在每次计算后交换结果。 HeteroInfer 没有公开代码，因此我们根据论文自行实现了这种分割方式。 HeteroVDiff 在每个工作负载中，于 Equation 4 基于联合运行速率选定的 k b k_{b} 位置处设置一个块级切割点，即 51/51、54/54、59/59 和 61/61。

At 49 frames it completes a video every 677 677 s against 917 917 s, which is 5.3 5.3 against 3.9 3.9 videos per hour, a gain of 1.35 × 1.35{\times} . The gain rises to 1.50 × 1.50{\times} at 17 frames. paragraphs.en: Naive data parallelism comes closest on throughput and loses on the SLO axis. It reaches 1.32 1.32 – 1.42 × 1.42{\times} , 0.6 0.6 – 6.4 % 6.4\% behind HeteroVDiff at the four workloads. Under the SLO every video DP adds over NPU-only misses the deadline. Each DP video is generated entirely by one engine, so the added videos all come from the GPU arm. A GPU-arm video takes 2,620 2{,}620 s at 49 frames against the deadline of 1,375 1{,}375 s. The added videos are therefore unusable, and DP’s SLO-compliant rate is its NPU arm alone. That is the NPU-only rate, 3.9 3.9 videos per hour against HeteroVDiff ’s 5.3 5.3 . HeteroVDiff meets the deadline because every video crosses both engines and none takes longer than 1,325 1{,}325 s. Hetero-Tensor finishes a video in 860.5 860.5 s at 49 frames, 0.94 × 0.94{\times} NPU-only, because the per-GEMM split saves about 50 50 ms of GEMM time per block and pays 155 155 ms of waiting and cache maintenance, so the 4,680 4{,}680 hand-offs per video cost more time than the GPU’s slices save. GPU-only completes at 0.35 0.35 – 0.48 × 0.48{\times} .
paragraphs.zh: 朴素的数据并行在吞吐量上表现最佳，但在 SLO 指标上则处于劣势。 在四种工作负载下，其性能达到 1.32–1.42×，比 HeteroVDiff 慢 0.6–6.4%。 在 SLO 要求下，每个视频数据并行方案都会超出仅使用 NPU 时的延迟限制。 每个数据并行视频完全由一个引擎生成，因此所有新增视频均来自 GPU 端。 在 49 帧的情况下，GPU 端生成一个视频需要 2,620 秒，而延迟限制为 1,375 秒。 因此，这些新增视频无法使用，数据并行方案符合 SLO 的速率仅取决于其 NPU 端。 也就是说，仅使用 NPU 时的速率为每小时 3.9 个视频，而 HeteroVDiff 的速率为 5.3 个视频。 HeteroVDiff 能够按时完成任务，因为每个视频都会经过两个引擎，且没有任何一个视频的生成时间超过 1,325 秒。 Hetero-Tensor 在 49 帧的情况下完成一个视频需要 860.5 秒，仅为仅使用 NPU 时的 0.94×；这是因为每次 GEMM 操作的分片为每个块节省了约 50 毫秒的 GEMM 时间，但需要付出 155 毫秒的等待和缓存维护成本，因此视频中 4,680 次数据传递所消耗的时间超过了 GPU 分片节省的时间。 仅使用 GPU 时的完成速率为 0.35–0.48×。

paragraphs.en: Concurrent execution across a phone’s processors is established for language and perception models ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Dagli and Belviranli, 2024 ; Jeong et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2023 ) , and differs from HeteroVDiff in two ways. They synchronise at every layer or tensor slice, about 400 400 µs per crossing by HeteroInfer’s measurement ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Video diffusion makes that far more expensive because every block runs once per denoising step. Our six-step, 30-block workload executes N ⋅ L = 180 N{\cdot}L{=}180 blocks per video, so a per-layer scheme would cross at least 180 times where HeteroVDiff crosses once. They also keep weights in each runtime’s own layout. HeteroInfer gives the engines disjoint slices of one matrix. And BlastNet, CoDL, and μ \mu Layer duplicate or reformat blocks per processor ( Ling et al., 2022 ; Jia et al., 2022 ; Kim et al., 2019 ) . HeRo aliases one buffer across the QNN and OpenCL runtimes through CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR ( Li et al., 2026a ) only for inter-stage activations, while weights stay one copy per backend. None lets two runtimes consume the same persistent weight bytes, the problem § 4.2 solves.
paragraphs.zh: 手机处理器之间的并行执行已用于语言模型和感知模型（Chen et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025；Xue et al., 2024；Wei et al., 2023；Dagli and Belviranli, 2024；Jeong et al., 2022；Park et al., 2023），这与 HeteroVDiff 存在两处不同。 它们在每一层或张量切片处进行同步，根据 HeteroInfer 的测量，每次穿越约需 400 400 µs（Chen et al., 2025）。 视频扩散使这一过程的成本高得多，因为每个块在每次去噪步骤中都会运行一次。 我们的六步、三十块的工作负载每段视频执行 N ⋅ L = 180 N{\cdot}L{=}180 个块，因此逐层方案至少需要穿越 180 次，而 HeteroVDiff 仅需穿越一次。 它们还将权重保留在各自运行时自身的布局中。 HeteroInfer 为各个引擎提供同一矩阵的不连续切片。 此外，BlastNet、CoDL 和 μ \mu Layer 会按处理器复制或重新格式化块（Ling et al., 2022；Jia et al., 2022；Kim et al., 2019）。 HeRo 通过 CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR（Li et al., 2026a）将 QNN 和 OpenCL 运行时共享一个缓冲区的别名，但仅用于阶段间的激活值，而权重在每个后端中仍保持一份独立副本。 这些方法均未允许两个运行时共享相同的持久化权重字节，而这正是 § 4.2 所解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Co-execution on mobile SoCs has been characterised as a cost, or at best as aggregate bandwidth recovered from idle memory channels ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . HaX-CoNN models GPU–DSP contention as slowdown ( Dagli and Belviranli, 2024 ) , Agent.xpu reports NPU–GPU interference on an AI PC as degradation or neutrality ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , Sereno finds on this SoC that NPU inference degrades foreground rendering ( Xin et al., 2026 ) , and the one documented cross-component dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) coupling in mobile inference is antagonistic ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Their co-runners are separate models or interactive rendering ( Ye and Huang, 2026 ; Murthy et al., 2026 ) ; none places a cut from rates that co-execution itself changes, so HeteroVDiff measures its rates with both engines running, where they move in opposite directions.
paragraphs.zh: 移动系统级芯片（SoC）上的协同执行已被描述为一种成本，或者在最佳情况下，是从空闲内存通道中恢复的总带宽（Chen 等，2025）。 HaX-CoNN 将 GPU–DSP 的竞争视为性能下降（Dagli 和 Belviranli，2024）；Agent.xpu 报告称 AI PC 上的 NPU–GPU 干扰表现为性能下降或中性（Wei 等，2025）；Sereno 发现，在该 SoC 上，NPU 推理会损害前景渲染（Xin 等，2026）；而移动推理中唯一记录下来的跨组件动态电压和频率缩放（DVFS）耦合是相互对抗的（Zhang 等，2026b）。 它们的协同运行程序是独立的模型或交互式渲染（Ye 和 Huang，2026；Murthy 等，2026）；没有任何一种方法会切断协同执行本身所改变的执行速率，因此 HeteroVDiff 在两个引擎同时运行时测量其速率，此时它们的速率变化方向相反。

paragraphs.en: Prior on-device diffusion makes the model smaller and runs it on one engine. Image systems pair efficient architectures with GPU-aware kernels on a single engine ( Li et al., 2023b ; Zhao et al., 2024b ) ; Speed Is All You Need already keeps a materialised score matrix with a partially fused softmax on Adreno, reserving fused FlashAttention for head dimension 40 ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , and we re-adopt that structure at head dimension 128, in INT8, and at video sequence length rather than claim it. Video systems retrain compact models ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025a ) , prune tokens or distil steps ( Li et al., 2026b ; Ben Yahia et al., 2025 ; Karnewar et al., 2026 ) , or page blocks in on demand ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , all orthogonal to HeteroVDiff , which keeps the model and changes where it runs. The closest vendor systems run entirely on the Hexagon NPU and leave the GPU idle ( Karnewar et al., 2026 ; Ghafoorian et al., 2026 ) . MobileWan also splits its block sequence, but within the NPU to fit memory, unloading and reloading at every boundary; S 2 DiT gives the GPU only the decoder, so its engines run in sequence ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; CODA disaggregates video diffusion across two units, but needs near-memory hardware phones lack and overlaps only classifier-free guidance branches our model lacks ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在设备上进行预扩散使模型更小，并可在单个引擎上运行。 图像系统将高效的架构与针对 GPU 优化的内核结合到单个引擎中（Li et al., 2023b; Zhao et al., 2024b）；Speed Is All You Need 已经在 Adreno 上保留了经过部分融合的 softmax 的显式得分矩阵，并将融合后的 FlashAttention 保留用于头维度为 40 的情况（Chen et al., 2023），而我们在头维度为 128、使用 INT8 以及视频序列长度下重新采用了这种结构，而非仅仅声称如此。 视频系统会重新训练紧凑型模型（Wu et al., 2025b; Wu et al., 2025a）、剪枝标记或蒸馏步骤（Li et al., 2026b; Ben Yahia et al., 2025; Karnewar et al., 2026），或者按需分页块（Kim et al., 2026）；这些方法都与 HeteroVDiff 相互独立，因为 HeteroVDiff 保留模型本身，仅改变其运行位置。 最接近的厂商系统完全在 Hexagon NPU 上运行，而 GPU 则处于空闲状态（Karnewar et al., 2026; Ghafoorian et al., 2026）。 MobileWan 也会分割其块序列，但这一操作在 NPU 内部进行以适配内存，并在每个边界处卸载和重新加载；S 2 DiT 仅将解码器交给 GPU，因此其引擎按顺序运行（Zhao et al., 2026）；CODA 则将视频扩散分解到两个单元中运行，但这需要接近内存的硬件，而手机缺乏这种硬件，且 CODA 仅与我们模型所没有的分类器自由引导分支存在重叠（Zhang et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: The closest vendor systems run entirely on the Hexagon NPU and leave the GPU idle ( Karnewar et al., 2026 ; Ghafoorian et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 最接近的厂商系统完全在 Hexagon NPU 上运行，而 GPU 则处于空闲状态（Karnewar et al., 2026; Ghafoorian et al., 2026）。

sents.en: MobileWan also splits its block sequence, but within the NPU to fit memory, unloading and reloading at every boundary; S 2 DiT gives the GPU only the decoder, so its engines run in sequence ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; CODA disaggregates video diffusion across two units, but needs near-memory hardware phones lack and overlaps only classifier-free guidance branches our model lacks ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: MobileWan 也会分割其块序列，但这一操作在 NPU 内部进行以适配内存，并在每个边界处卸载和重新加载；S 2 DiT 仅将解码器交给 GPU，因此其引擎按顺序运行（Zhao et al., 2026）；CODA 则将视频扩散分解到两个单元中运行，但这需要接近内存的硬件，而手机缺乏这种硬件，且 CODA 仅与我们模型所没有的分类器自由引导分支存在重叠（Zhang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: HeteroVDiff serves a multi-expert video diffusion model across the NPU and the GPU of one phone from a single stored copy of its weights. The base weights live in one INT8 artifact laid out as the NPU reads it and consumed by the GPU as integer dot-product operands. The second expert is a rank-128 factor on top of that base. And the denoising trajectory is cut once at a block boundary so that the GPU runs the prefix of the next video while the NPU finishes the current one. On a Galaxy S25 this completes a 49-frame video every 677 677 s against 917 917 s for NPU-only execution, a stream-throughput gain of 1.35 × 1.35\times that rises to 1.50 × 1.50\times at 17 frames, while staying within 0.2 0.2 pp of FP32 in VBench Quality score and 1.3 1.3 pp in VBench-2.0 Total score. The general lesson is that two accelerators should share weight bytes rather than arithmetic on a shared-memory SoC, and the cut between them must be placed from co-run rates that include the decoder.
paragraphs.zh: HeteroVDiff 通过单个存储的权重副本，在单部手机的 NPU 和 GPU 上运行一个多专家视频扩散模型。 基础权重以单个 INT8 数据块的形式存在：NPU 按该格式读取，GPU 则将其作为整数点积操作数使用。 第二个专家是在此基础之上叠加的一个秩为 128 的因子。 去噪轨迹会在一个区块边界处被切断一次，以便 GPU 运行下一段视频的前缀部分，同时 NPU 完成当前视频的生成。 在 Galaxy S25 上，这种方法每 677 677 秒可生成一个 49 帧的视频，而仅使用 NPU 执行则需要 917 917 秒，实现了 1.35 × 1.35\times 的流式吞吐量提升；在 17 帧时，该提升进一步增至 1.50 × 1.50\times，同时 VBench Quality 分数与 FP32 的差距保持在 0.2 0.2 pp 以内，VBench-2.0 Total 分数的差距则控制在 1.3 1.3 pp 以内。 总体经验是：在共享内存 SoC 上，两个加速器应共享权重字节而非共享算术运算资源，且它们之间的切换点必须基于包含解码器的协同运行速率来确定。

paragraphs.en: Multi-expert diffusion models specialise different timestep or noise regimes with different denoiser parameters. For example, Wan2.2-A14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) stores separate 14 14 B high-noise and low-noise transformers and selects between them using a fixed timestep boundary. TimeStep Master ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) attaches multiple timestep-specialised LoRA experts to a shared backbone, including eight fine-grained core experts and four coarser context experts. These experts are lightweight adapters rather than independently stored denoisers. DCM ( Lv et al., 2025 ) freezes its distilled semantic expert and uses it as a shared backbone. It forms the detail expert by adding new timestep-embedding layers and rank-128 LoRA adapters to the attention projections. Figure 2 shows its inference pipeline. Together, the two 14 14 B INT8 experts of Wan2.2-A14B require 28 28 GB. Even if the pair were factorised post hoc into a shared base plus low-rank adapters, the 14 14 B base alone would still exceed our target platform’s memory budget unless it were distilled to a smaller model. DCM shares parameters by construction. Its semantic expert is the shared base of 1,419 1{,}419 M parameters, and the detail expert adds only a rank-128 attention adapter of 94.4 94.4 M parameters and a new timestep-embedding block of 25.6 25.6 M parameters. We therefore use the two expert model DCM-Wan2.1 as our implementation and evaluation workload. This choice is dictated by storage feasibility rather than convenience.
paragraphs.zh: 多专家扩散模型通过不同的去噪参数，为不同的时间步或噪声机制分配专门的专家。 例如，Wan2.2-A14B（Wan 等人，2025）存储了独立的 141.4B 高噪声和低噪声变换器，并使用固定的时间步边界在二者之间进行选择。 TimeStep Master（Zhuang 等人，2025）将多个专门处理不同时间步的 LoRA 专家附加到一个共享主干网络中，包括八个精细的核心专家和四个较粗的上下文专家。 这些专家是轻量级的适配器，而非独立存储的去噪器。 DCM（Lv 等人，2025）冻结了其蒸馏后的语义专家，并将其用作共享主干网络。 它通过向注意力投影中添加新的时间步嵌入层和秩为 128 的 LoRA 适配器来构建细节专家。 图 2 展示了其推理流程。 Wan2.2-A14B 的两个 141.4B INT8 专家合计需要 28 GB 内存。 即使事后将这对模型分解为一个共享基模型和低秩适配器，仅 141.4B 的基模型本身也会超出我们目标平台的内存预算，除非将其蒸馏为更小的模型。 DCM 在结构上就实现了参数共享。 其语义专家是包含 1,419M 参数的共享基模型，而细节专家仅增加了一个秩为 128 的注意力适配器（94.4M 参数）和一个新的时间步嵌入模块（25.6M 参数）。 因此，我们选择双专家模型 DCM-Wan2.1 作为我们的实现和评估基准。 这一选择是由存储可行性决定的，而非便利性。

paragraphs.en: The Snapdragon 8 Elite SoC ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e ) used in Samsung Galaxy S25 platform exposes two programmable accelerators that share a unified memory pool, shown in Figure 8 . The Hexagon V79 NPU contains a VLIW DSP, a 1024-bit SIMD vector unit (HVX), and a matrix unit (HMX). HMX multiplies a 32 × 32 32{\times}32 tile of activations by a 32 × 32 32{\times}32 tile of weights. Both operands must already sit in VTCM, in the tile order the hardware expects ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2026 ) . HMX supports INT2, INT4, INT8, INT16, FP8, and FP16 with mixed-precision support ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e ) . Reachable throughput is gated by the FastRPC ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024b ) channel between the application processor and the compute DSP (cDSP), the subsystem that hosts the NPU. Programs are typically delivered as offline-compiled Qualcomm AI Engine Direct (QNN) context binaries ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024c ) . The toolchain hardcodes input shapes at build time and refuses to serialise graphs whose activation footprint exceeds an internal limit, a constraint we revisit in § 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 三星 Galaxy S25 平台使用的骁龙 8 Elite SoC（Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e）暴露出两个可编程加速器，它们共享一个统一内存池，如第 8 图所示。 Hexagon V79 NPU 包含一个 VLIW DSP、一个 1024 位 SIMD 向量单元（HVX）和一个矩阵单元（HMX）。 HMX 将 32×32 的激活值瓦片与 32×32 的权重瓦片相乘。 两个操作数都必须已存在于 VTCM 中，且顺序需符合硬件的预期（Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2026）。 HMX 支持 INT2、INT4、INT8、INT16、FP8 和 FP16，并具备混合精度支持（Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024e）。 可达到的吞吐量受应用处理器与计算 DSP（cDSP）之间的 FastRPC（Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024b）通道限制，而 cDSP 正是 NPU 所在的子系统。 程序通常以离线编译的 Qualcomm AI Engine Direct（QNN）上下文二进制文件形式交付（Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024c）。 工具链在构建时硬编码输入形状，并拒绝序列化其激活值占用空间超过内部限制的图，这一限制我们将在 §6 中再次探讨。

paragraphs.en: The Adreno 830 GPU ( Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., 2024a ) exposes INT8 compute through an OpenCL integer dot-product instruction ( dp4a ). It has no matrix unit. HMX keeps a tile resident and reuses it in hardware. On the GPU every load from DRAM must be scheduled and reused by the kernel itself. A general matrix multiplication (GEMM) reuses each load heavily and attention barely does, which is why the GPU slows down at attention.

paragraphs.en: The system kernel reports 10.85 10.85 GiB of usable memory on this device. Adreno advertises a maximum OpenCL buffer size of 1024 1024 MiB, and § 3 shows that the actual limit is lower. paragraphs.en: Two strategies dominate prior work on splitting an inference workload across multiple accelerators on the same SoC. Layer partition (e.g., HeteroInfer ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , NN-Stretch ( Wei et al., 2023 ) , and Heimdall ( Yi and Lee, 2020 ) ) places a contiguous prefix of model layers on one device and the suffix on another, handing off the activation tensor at each boundary. This strategy incurs at least one cross-device handoff per layer split. An LLM crosses that boundary once per token. A diffusion model would cross it once per block of every step, which is N ⋅ L N{\cdot}L times for a single video. Expert partition is used in mobile MoE deployment ( LLM, 2025 ; Nachin et al., 2026 ) , which places different experts on different devices and routes tokens dynamically.
paragraphs.zh: 在将推理工作负载分配到同一 SoC 上的多个加速器方面，此前的研究主要采用两种策略。 层级划分（例如 HeteroInfer (Chen et al., 2025)、NN-Stretch (Wei et al., 2023) 和 Heimdall (Yi and Lee, 2020)）将模型层的连续前缀部分放置在一个设备上，后缀部分放置在另一个设备上，并在每个边界处传递激活张量。 这种策略在每次层级划分时至少会产生一次跨设备传递。 一个 LLM 每处理一个词符就会跨越该边界一次。 扩散模型则会在每一步的每个块中跨越该边界一次，因此单个视频需要跨越 N ⋅ L 次。 专家划分被用于移动端的 MoE 部署（LLM, 2025；Nachin et al., 2026），它将不同的专家分配到不同设备，并动态路由词符。

paragraphs.en: The denoising trajectory gives diffusion models a third axis that LLMs do not have. A video synthesiser runs the same DiT graph N N times against a common latent, with no token-level dependency between steps. Few-step distillation has pushed N N from 25 − 50 25{-}50 down to 4 − 8 4{-}8 , which shrinks the trajectory but does not remove the axis. Step partition runs steps 0 . . k − 1 0..k{-}1 on one accelerator and steps k . . N − 1 k..N{-}1 on another, with a single latent handoff in the middle. The handoff cost is then O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) per video rather than O ⁡ ( N ⋅ L ) O(N{\cdot}L) for L L blocks. This matters because every synchronisation between the two accelerators has a fixed cost ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 去噪轨迹为扩散模型提供了大型语言模型所不具备的第三个维度。视频合成器将相同的 DiT 图在共享的潜在表示上运行 N 次，各步骤之间不存在词元级别的依赖关系。少步蒸馏已将 N 从 25−50 降低到 4−8，这缩短了轨迹，但并未消除该维度。步骤分区则将步骤 0..k−1 运行在一个加速器上，步骤 k..N−1 运行在另一个加速器上，中间仅进行一次潜在表示的传递。因此，每次视频的手续传递成本为 O(1)，而非 L 个块时的 O(N⋅L)。这一点至关重要，因为两个加速器之间的每一次同步都会产生固定的成本（Chen 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: The NPU executor of Figure 3 is a custom FastRPC package. Within it, HeteroVDiff ports the open-source htp-ops-lib HMX FlashAttention kernel ( Hao et al., 2026 ) to the model’s video shapes. The executor creates a six-context HVX worker pool, enables HMX for those workers, and dispatches every attention kernel through that pool. The deployed workload does not use an attention mask, so the executor takes an unmasked path and never allocates the M × M M{\times}M zero-valued mask tensor that a generic kernel would read.

paragraphs.en: The port fixes two library routines that were wrong for this model. The softmax exponential was a lookup table that is accurate only for small attention scores, and at this model’s score magnitudes its output correlates with an FP64 reference at only 0.65 0.65 . We replace it with a polynomial exp2 in FP16 on HVX, which is correct at every magnitude we tested and costs about 1.2 × 1.2\times in attention time. The FP32-to-FP16 cast, which the executor applies wherever the FP32 residual stream enters a GEMM, used a packing instruction that interleaves its two input vectors, so the outputs came out in the wrong order. One de-interleave step after it makes the cast bit-exact.
paragraphs.zh: 该端口修复了两个对于此模型而言存在错误的库程序。 Softmax 指数原本是一个查找表，仅在小注意力分数下准确；而在此模型的分数量级上，其输出与 FP64 参考值的关联度仅为 0.65 0.65。 我们将其替换为 HVX 上以 FP16 格式实现的多项式 exp2，该实现在我们测试的所有量级下均准确无误，且注意力时间成本约为原来的 1.2 × 1.2\times。 FP32 到 FP16 的类型转换由执行器在 FP32 残差流进入 GEMM 时自动应用，但此过程使用了一个交错两个输入向量的打包指令，导致输出顺序错误。 在完成类型转换后，只需一个解交错步骤即可使结果达到位精确。

paragraphs.en: HMX GEMMs consume FP16 operands, so the NPU dequantises the two feed-forward matrices of the shared INT8 base once per block into a reusable FP16 scratch buffer. HVX reorders and widens the tiled INT8 values, then applies the per-column scales. All output chunks in that block reuse the converted weights before the scratch buffer is recycled for the next block.
paragraphs.zh: HMX GEMM 操作使用 FP16 操作数，因此 NPU 会在每个块中仅对共享的 INT8 基底的两个前馈矩阵进行一次反量化，生成可重复使用的 FP16 临时缓冲区。 HVX 会重排并扩展分块的 INT8 值，然后应用每列的缩放因子。 该块中的所有输出片段都会在临时缓冲区被回收用于下一个块之前，重复使用已转换的权重。

The base weights never change, so the expert switch moves no weights.

paragraphs.en: The GPU DiT executor of Figure 3 implements each block as a sequence of OpenCL kernels that read the shared base-weight artifact directly. Attention is split into a query-key GEMM, a row-wise softmax, and an attention-value GEMM. This structure gives the integer dot-product kernels the operand reuse of the GEMM mainloop, and it keeps each dispatch to tens of milliseconds. Our fused INT8 kernel, which launched the whole sequence as one dispatch, was killed before it completed at the deployment length.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 中的 GPU DiT 执行器将每个块实现为一系列 OpenCL 内核的序列，这些内核直接读取共享的基础权重工件。 注意力机制被拆分为一个查询-键 GEMM、一个行方向的 softmax 和一个注意力-值 GEMM。 这种结构使得整数点积内核能够复用 GEMM 主循环的操作数，并且每次调度所需时间保持在数十毫秒以内。 我们融合后的 INT8 内核将整个序列作为一次调度启动，但在部署长度下尚未完成便被终止了。

paragraphs.en: The NPU runs the VAE decoder through the QNN HTP backend after the final denoising step. The QNN GPU backend does not provide the required three-dimensional convolution. On the QNN HTP backend, the floating-point version fails during graph preparation, while the INT8 version compiles. The decoder is therefore implemented as an INT8 QNN HTP graph.
paragraphs.zh: 在最终的去噪步骤之后，NPU 通过 QNN HTP 后端运行 VAE 解码器。 QNN GPU 后端不提供所需的三维卷积操作。 在 QNN HTP 后端上，浮点版本在图准备阶段失败，而 INT8 版本则成功编译。 因此，该解码器被实现为一个 INT8 QNN HTP 图。

paragraphs.en: The first frame and later frames use separate QNN HTP context binaries. The first frame skips a temporal upsampling operation, while later frames read and update the recurrent feature cache. A zero-filled cache is not equivalent to the first-frame computation, so the runtime selects the appropriate context for each frame.
paragraphs.zh: 第一帧和后续帧使用独立的 QNN HTP 上下文二进制文件。 第一帧跳过时间上采样操作，而后续帧则读取并更新循环特征缓存。 用零填充的缓存与第一帧的计算并不等价，因此运行时为每帧选择适当的上下文。

paragraphs.en: The recurrent feature cache also rules out decoding a whole frame at once, because the graph’s estimated allocation exceeds the toolchain’s 2 GiB per-graph ceiling. HeteroVDiff therefore divides each latent frame into spatial VAE tiles and uses the largest tile we found to compile under that ceiling, 60 × 40 60{\times}40 latent pixels, three per frame. Tiles are decoded one after another, and each keeps its own recurrent cache across all frames of the clip, so only one tile’s cache is resident at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 循环特征缓存也排除了同时解码整个帧的可能性，因为该图的预估分配量超过了工具链每个图 2 GiB 的上限。 因此，HeteroVDiff 将每个潜在帧划分为空间 VAE 瓦片，并使用我们在此上限下成功编译的最大瓦片：60 × 40 个潜在像素，每帧三个。 这些瓦片依次解码，且每个瓦片在整个视频片段的所有帧中都保留其自身的循环缓存，因此每次只有一个瓦片的缓存处于驻留状态。
